title: A cache that does not leak
prompt:
Implement `class WeakCache`:

- `put(key, obj)` stores a WEAK reference to obj under key
- `get(key)` returns the live object, or None once it has been garbage-collected (or was never put)
- optional `default_factory(key)` builds and caches the object on a miss (also weakly)

Graded probe: objects are created with no strong references left; after `gc.collect()`, `get` must return None — a strong-reference cache fails this.

tests.name: collected objects vanish from the cache
tests.code:
import gc

class Thing:
    pass

c = WeakCache()
t = Thing()
c.put('k', t)
assert c.get('k') is t
del t
gc.collect()
assert c.get('k') is None, 'weak cache must let collected objects go'
print('ok')
tests.hint: weakref.ref(obj) stored per key; call the ref to get the object or None.

tests.name: default_factory builds on miss
tests.hint: On miss with a factory: build, store weakly, return. (Payload keeps __weakref__ — plain dicts cannot be weak-referenced.)
